name: Maine Results, Inc.
description:
Maine Results Inc., doing business as G3 Carpentry, is a Boise, Idaho–based restoration, repair, and custom carpentry company serving homeowners and property owners throughout the Treasure Valley. Led by owner John R. Wilkins, the company specializes in craftsmanship-driven carpentry repairs, wood restoration, finish trim, custom built-ins, and practical solutions for water, rot, storm, and general property damage.

Business Overview
Founded by John Wilkins, Maine Results Inc. reflects his decades of experience building and operating contracting businesses in Philadelphia, Maine, and Idaho. The company operates under the G3 Carpentry name and positions itself around a simple standard: “Craftsmanship cannot be mass produced.”

Rather than focusing on high-volume production work, Maine Results emphasizes careful assessment, durable repairs, clear communication, and workmanship that holds up over time. The business serves residential clients, landlords, property managers, and owners of older or damaged homes who need a dependable contractor for restoration and repair projects.

Core Services
Maine Results Inc. provides a broad range of carpentry, restoration, and repair services, including:

Restoration and repair carpentry

Wood rot, dry rot, and water-damage repair

Rotten wood replacement and preventive repairs

Door installation, adjustment, repair, and restoration

Door frame, jamb, casing, and trim repair

Window trim, sill, frame, and casing repair

Interior and exterior trim installation and repair

Baseboard, crown molding, and decorative trim work

Custom built-ins, shelving, bookcases, cabinets, and entertainment centers

Custom fireplace mantels, home bars, pantries, and cabinet doors

Deck building, deck repair, and exterior carpentry

Finish carpentry and fine woodworking

Punch-list repairs, warranty repairs, and rental-property repairs

General carpentry and construction services

Public service listings specifically identify the company’s offerings as including baseboard installation, cabinet repair, carpentry, crown molding, custom bookcases, custom built-ins, custom doors, custom shelving, deck building and repair, finish carpentry, and related work.

Restoration Focus
A defining strength of Maine Results is repair-first restoration. Instead of automatically recommending full replacement, John Wilkins evaluates whether damaged doors, frames, trim, or wood components can be repaired effectively—often saving clients money while preserving the original character of the property.

Customer reviews highlight this approach in practice: one Boise client reported that John repaired water-damaged and rotten wood in a door opening and took steps to prevent future problems; another said he repaired interior doors that appeared to require full frame replacement, completing the work for about one-third of the expected cost.

Client Experience
Maine Results is known for responsive scheduling, straightforward estimates, detailed explanations, and follow-through. Reviews consistently mention punctuality, professionalism, clear communication, reasonable pricing, attention to detail, and a willingness to return for minor adjustments after the initial project.

Clients also value that John explains what he is doing, why it is necessary, and what options are available before work begins. This consultative approach helps homeowners make informed decisions about repairs, replacements, materials, and long-term maintenance.

Service Area
The company is based in Boise and serves the surrounding Treasure Valley, including communities such as Meridian, Star, Caldwell, and nearby residential areas. Its Boise location is listed at 11682 W. Camas St., Boise, ID 83709.

Positioning Statement
Maine Results Inc. is a Boise-based restoration and repair contractor specializing in high-quality carpentry, custom woodwork, and durable property repairs. The company helps homeowners and property owners solve damage, deterioration, and finish-carpentry problems with careful craftsmanship, honest recommendations, and repair-first solutions that protect both the property and the client’s investment.

Idaho contractor registration: Maine Results Inc. holds a General Contractor Registration license with Idaho’s licensing authority, according to BuildZoom’s contractor profile Lic #RCE 43565.

Business registration: Maine Results Inc. is registered in Idaho, with public corporate records listing the company and its Boise address.

BBB business profile: The Better Business Bureau has a profile for Maine Results Inc. under Construction Services.

Professional education: John’s LinkedIn profile lists study in Building Engineering at Wentworth Institute of Technology.
